notes.title: UPDATE 3 OUT NOW - New game mode Prophunt and introducing Cookie
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/81506dab19987af98de80752f376fe14f2fd6874.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Hello Neighbors![/b]   [/p][p]Update 3 is finally here and we are excited to bring new content and quality of life updates across the board. Today we are happy to release the third major content update [b]HIDE THE COOKIES! [/b][/p][p][/p][h1]WHAT IS IN THIS UPDATE?[/h1][p]Big update time! Read on, or watch the video recap below. [/p][previewyoutube="--FwA_4sun8;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2][b]NEW NEIGHBOR: Cookie [/b][/h2][p]Meet Cookie, Heartsville's newest resident![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/48f3e7ca825ffcfa63efca6a6fab2f03a4c1ed0c.png"][/img][/p][p]Cookie is the neighborhoods infiltrator and saboteur. With her arsenal of scout skills and her trusty Multi-Tool, Cookie is ready to take out traps, disguise as a bush or tunnel her way across the Cul-De-Sac.
[/p][h3][b]Multi-Tool- Primary[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Attack:[/b] Cookie does a light melee attack.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Multi-Tool- Secondary[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Disassemble:[/b] Cookie Disassembles a trap in front of her, making her able to steal it.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Abilities[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Tunnel Digging (Default):[/b] Equip a shovel to dig a tunnel. When two tunnels have been placed, you can travel between them.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Camouflage (Level 5 unlock):[/b] Cookie gathers twigs and branches to quickly camouflage herself as a bush. She takes reduced damage while Camouflage is active.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Magpie Mayhem (Level 10 unlock):[/b] Cookie calls on her animal friends to protect her. Enemies that gets too close gets harassed by birds.[/p][/*][/list][p]
You can see Cookies character highlight here:[/p][previewyoutube="jZlkKTvmtBE;full"][/previewyoutube][h2][b]NEW GAME MODE: Prop Hunt[/b][/h2][p]The new game mode Prop Hunt is here! Play hide-and-seek with your neighbors, where one team hides as props around the property, and the other tries to find and eliminate them before time runs out. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/994ec702c1fcdff872bfcbd41429237140fab993.gif"][/img][/p][h2][b]
NEW BRAWL MAP: Harmony Foundation[/b][/h2][p]Harmony Foundation joins the neighborhood, as the new brawl map. This under-construction part of the neighborhood provides and all-new playground for knocking out your favorite frenemy neighbors. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/6a5be72ce0d5395bcf1c3fe60eed85fc5b5a8665.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]BRAWL IN ALL EXISTING MAPS[/b][/h2][p]The Brawl gamemode will now be available in all existing maps, previously exclusive for the Destruction gamemode![/p][p][/p][h2][b]MENU REWORK FOR EASY REPLAYABILITY[/b][/h2][h3][b]Moving from dedicated servers to listen servers[/b] [/h3][p]In this update for are moving away from dedicated servers to make the creation and joining of different game modes more straightforward. We might get dedicated servers back in the future should the need arise but we felt this was the best way forward at this point in time. Together with the new  [b]replay functionality [/b]at the end of each match, we hope this will make it easier for people to find games, try out different game modes and have fun with their friends while we continue development! 
[i](This change means that leaderboards will be temporarily removed from the game. We hope to have them back within long!)[/i]

[/p][h2][b]MIXED QUALITY OF LIFE[/b][/h2][p]In addition to the above, this update also brings with it a series of Quality of Life improvements and new customization. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Doubled the amount of XP gained[/b][/h3][p]This is a long overdue change. For a while now it has been clear that the progression in the game lacked balancing. We are taking steps to address that now. Moving forward all experience gained during play will be doubled. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/88a04e1a9f711f3489d01973175efe97e31bf3b6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Spawn protection in Brawl[/b][/h3][p]Together with the new brawler map, this update also introduces increased spawn protection when playing in brawl mode. We hope this help to alleviate some of the pain points that has been reported from this game mode.  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Updated screen and UI effects[/b][/h3][p]Several of the existing screen effects has had their visuals reworked. In addition, UI elements such as the ability icon and health bar have received additional functionality in order to make it easier for the players to understand and notice what is going on. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]NEW ITEM SKINS[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Glitter Wrench[/p][/*][*][p]Glitter Med-Kit[/p][/*][*][p]Glitter Sabotage Tool[/p][/*][*][p]Camo Sabotage Tool[/p][/*][*][p]Camo Wrench[/p][/*][/list][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/959b951b14791762095fbe215a15a0f2c497eaa9.png"][/img][/h2][h3][b]NEW CHARACTER SKINS[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Poodle Cookie[/p][/*][*][p]Junior Scout Cookie[/p][/*][*][p]Biker Doreen[/p][/*][*][p]Teddy Bear Kevin

notes.title: A little Prophunt Game Mode teaser, new Neighbor & more!
notes.notes:
[p]G'day Neighbors!

If you haven't already heard from [url="https://discord.gg/invisiblewalls"]Discord[/url] announcement, the next content update will feature a new gamemode called Prophunt! For those unaware, Prophunt consists of two teams; the props and the hunters. Props must disguise as objects within the world in order to avoid being captured by the hunters. Hunters are blindfolded during the beginning of a round, giving props ample time to find the perfect hiding spot - but beware! If you stand still too long as a prop, you will begin to whistle, alerting the hunters of your presence.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/994ec702c1fcdff872bfcbd41429237140fab993.gif"][/img][/p][p]
Since we're making Prophunt à la Neighbors, there's a couple of additional twists. First of all, each team still gets to pick their house. Every house in Neighbors fully supports Prophunt, giving you a lot of variety in the types of environments you can play in and the types of props you can disguise as. You also still get to play as your Neighbor when you're the hunter. This means that their traits (Movement speed, health, etc.) impacts how you play Prophunt, and most of them also retain their unique items.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/2890d008501691e0479a9a28849dca3bd419b37c.gif"][/img]  Part of this update also significantly improves the experience of hosting games, including implementing Play Again on self-hosted games. This makes it easier to either play endless rounds of Prophunt with your friends, or play a variety of different game modes across multiple matches - and yes MORE game modes are coming!

We can't wait to show you more details about the upcoming things very very soon! [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/d1f2f4f03c8f6dd44a4b2e3b168fc1d2a774efc6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you want to try out Prophunt early, get a sneak peak at the new [i][b]Neighbor[/b][/i](uuuhhhhh), we're doing a public playtest tomorrow [b]September 5th from 09:00 AM - 12:00 PM UTC[/b]. 

You read more about how to join on our [url="https://discord.gg/invisiblewalls"]Discord[/url]

I hope to hunt you all down as props in-game very soon!

Kind regards,
Daniel
Prophunt Connoisseur

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/599ec94778004f30bfe7ad9d526403477a44ecfd.png"][/img][i](nothing to see here)[/i]

notes.title: UPDATE 2 OUT NOW - Welcome to Paradise! | Leaderboard, New Map & New Houses
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/ae84346cb0682c542dd3d14849fac4961de834bd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Greetings Neighbors!   [/p][p]It has been a while, but we've been hard at work to bring a big update and today we have a BIG one. Strap in, put on the sunscreen and make sure to always stay hydrated.
[/p][p]Today we are happy to release our second major update [b]WELCOME TO PARADISE[/b]!!  Grab a cold drink, chill at the beach and smash the lovely summer houses of your neighbors.  Just a normal summer vacation in Heartsville i guess. 😎    [/p][h1]
WHAT IS IN THE UPDATE?[/h1][p][/p][h2][b]NEW MAP: PARADISE COVE [/b][/h2][p]If you’d ask the residents of Heartsville, what’s the perfect place to enjoy the beautiful summer temperatures and refreshing sea breeze there is only one answer they'd give you: [b]Paradise Cove.[/b]    [/p][p]Surrounded by palm trees and handcrafted tiki pillars is the perfect spot to catch some waves but beware since there have been sightings of hungry inhabitants of the sea.   [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/a2cde82ddc65d30c5ef7b444ccca08a66944398d.png"][/img][i]Due to rowdy neighbors somehow you can always find a construction site in every neighborhood.[/i]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/1b34c34a7c5f22a1b24a8c62e36b17d8a001dbc3.png"][/img][i]Handcrafted tiki pillars are disgusted by your lack of skill.[/i][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="JRBqcW4_DoM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]
Paradise Cove[/b] will be playable in custom lobbies and in competitive queue.   [/p][p][/p][h2][b]NEW HOUSES & SKINS[/b][/h2][p]Of course, a nice summer house is a key essential for every resident of Heartsville, which is why we are releasing not one, but two new houses to reinforce and defend.  [/p][p]Be it either the bamboo wrapped [b]Tropical Retreat[/b] or the more sophisticated and pompous [b]Sunset Villa[/b]. Either way you are going to enjoy your stay and love demolishing them. 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/389a678dabbb2b3ea0cf841d251a8e4fae6ca5d6.jpg"][/img][i]If the Tropical Retreat doesn't scream OHANA for you...get help.
[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/a34fe1fa52db792e6c2277a3b778a3ee5372796e.png"][/img][i]Tony Montana would be happy about the new[/i] [i]Sunset Villa[/i] 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/8063d9ae3dfd5de8e92d6d1c2f226bef6a622179.png"][/img][i]Our neighbors just hangin' around. And Gramps just casually wearing his Treasure Pirate costume.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]In addition to the new houses we are also adding more customzation possibilities via skins. Of course they fit the vacation and beach vibes with [b]Treasure Pirate Gramps[/b] leading the charge.    [/p][p][/p][h2][b]LEADERBOARD, COMPETITIVE & RESOURCES[/b][/h2][p]We’ve evaluated your feedback and concluded that removing the resources as a means to combat snowballing and the overall “sweatiness” of the game may have been a bit hasty. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/426fb2026b4472c5804c05808096ca7330f8da18.png"][/img]                         [i]A global leaderboard will track the wins and reset periodically.[/i] 

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Casual gamemodes will be separated from the matchmaking queue[/b] and will [b]only[/b] be playable via custom lobbies as our current server structure doesn't support two matchmaking queues. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/7af96142003225aa8d1e8935a46ba9fbb9fcada6.png"][/img]                    [b][i]Play![/i][/b][i] will now put players into a competitive queue with dedicated servers.
[/i][/p][/*][/olist][p]As mentioned in our Q&As our long-term goal for Neighbors is to bring in more game modes and possibly create a casual queue which will have all the fun party-ish game modes, but for the time being we decided to reserve matchmaking services for the competitive queue.

[/p][h2][b]QUALITY OF LIFE CHANGES[/b] [/h2][p]Being in Early Access it is only natural for us to discover possible gaps in the overall gameplay flow as we move along the development plan. For this update we took some time to work on heavily requested features.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/7eb455149dd4f8a3c0446ae4ff1d73352abcea3c.png[/img]
[h1][b]Hello dear Neighbors! [/b][/h1]

Today, we are happy to say that we are releasing our first “real” update! Thank you  for sticking with us and giving us your invaluable feedback during our early access!

Ever since the early stages of development we’ve wanted Neighbors to include a wide range of game modes and maps to offer more variety and make use of the opportunities we feel this universe has to offer. This update marks the first step in that direction. 

Based on feedback received during the initial part of the Early Access release (as well as testing conducted with some of you) we have also made the decision to make changes to the base game mode, Destruction. 

For a detailed breakdown of all the new things, read below! Otherwise we hope to see you in the neighborhood! 

- INVISIBLE WALLS

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Highlighted Features[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]New Game mode and Map[/b] [/h3]
We are excited to introduce you to the new game mode Team Brawl! Set in our new map, The F.I.N.E Depot, it’s a team based deathmatch where first to 25 knockouts win. This is a new way to play Neighbors which we expect will make it into our other maps within long. Have a look below and don't hesitate to give feedback once you've tried it out!
 
[previewyoutube=98M-gVmo0ow;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]Resource Changes[/b] [/h3]
Another significant change is that we are altering how resources work in our base game mode. Tiers in the shop now unlock automatically at night time, giving both teams a fair chance to obtain new items instead of the first team fight being all important. The resources will still spawn in the Construction Yard, but instead give money to the entire team when handed in.
This is our attempt at addressing some of the concerns related to snowballing and game complexity and was something that showed potential during a closed beta test. As always, we are listening intently with both ears to your feedback and are looking forward to see how this change affects your experience. If the change proves to work as we hope we expect to redesign the visuals of the resources to better reflect the new mechanics. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/06c351df5ad10121be4eb749a21e7b0622a31c20.png[/img]

[h3][b]New Item[/b] [/h3]
We have a long range of items lined up already. However, for this update we are happy to get the Pop Gun in the hands of our Neighbors. As a medium ranged Offensive weapon we can't wait to see what crazy plays will come out of it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/9c0f52a520485dc5ea073218f0543dd74ae24992.png[/img]

[h3][b]New Customization[/b] [/h3]
Detective P.A. has joined the shop to investigate the recent rise in crime and grindable Prototype Skins for select unique items have been added as the neighbors take the fight to the hardware store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/7bb77bf018c27a03ece2e7817a8e73ac69a4ca59.png[/img]

[*][b]New Customization:[/b] New Purchasable and Grindable Skins added to the shop

notes.title: 🏡 Bounties, multiple region select and tons of fixes! | Neighbors Patch #2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/b43f530eb4b020860adab938c9479ec94b79a2d7.png[/img]
[h1][b]Hello dear Neighbors! [/b][/h1]

It's a beefy post for you today, with a lot of good info, so strap in! 😀

If you'd rather get the full overview in video form, check out our community manager Artjom's video right here. Otherwise, dig into the text version below.

[previewyoutube=6k9XN7ffaVo;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Patch #2 Notes[/b] 📜[/h1]

Besides the launch of the ResourceRework beta we are also releasing our second patch today. With this patch we are addressing some of the biggest issues.

[expand type=showmore expanded=false]

[u][b][h2]Features[/h2][/b][/u]
[list]
[*] [b]Bounties:[/b] A new comeback mechanic to combat snowballing and nearly impossible comebacks after losing the initial fight at the construction yard. Players who are on a KO spree without getting knocked out will have a bounty on them, which the enemy team can claim by knocking them out. Players, who have been knocked out multiple times in a row now reward less money until they knocked someone out. 
[*] [b]Chat filter: [/b]A filter for angry people has been added to block some of the bad words they use. 
[*] [b]Multiple region selection: [/b]You can now select multiple regions for matchmaking.
[*] [b]Post Game Voice Chat: [/b]Players now have the possibility to congratulate each other after the game has ended using the in-game voice chat.
[*] [b]Crime Syndicate Skins: [/b]Grampsfather Gramps & Undercover Doreen have been added to the cosmetics shop
[/list]


[b][u][h2]Tweaks [/h2][/u][/b]

[list]
[*] General adjustment of every melee item to feel better if you are playing with a wider range of pings - the game should now feel more smooth if you have less than a perfect connection :) 
[*] Improved the hit registration of Chads Vacuum Cleaner shots.
[*] We have allowed the players to faster switch between items, independent of animation playback, which hopefully should be perceived less laggy; before the animation had to be finished before you could switch to another weapon/item.
[*] Changed some weapons to behave with line tracing rather than physicalized projectiles, which should lead to better hit registration. 
[*] Players should now be able to rejoin dedicated servers more reliably allowing for a longer period of time where we allow for rejoining the server if you happen to crash/lose connection.
[*] Continually adjusting the back-end matchmaking parameters and adjusting where needed.
[*] Went through all of the houses to make sure that they have the same amount of starting items – under evaluation for game balance adjustments.
[*] Kim’s wrench now has an updated model & rare skins.
[*] Oil Wells are no longer able to be placed inside.
[*] Removed hammers from all houses.
[*] Made it possible to open the main menu on the end screen.
[*] Reduced the damage on Louie's Rocket Barrage slightly
[*] - Max-range damage: 25→20
[*] - Mid-range damage: 20→15
[*] - Min-range damage 15→10
[*] - Medium Radius: 350→300
[*] - Close Radius: 200→150
[*] Speed up the level progression time on the scoring screen.
[*] The fireplace now lights up with just a single log.
[*] Reduced respawn rates slightly.
[/list]


[h2][u][b]Bugfixes[/b][/u][/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed cases where egg decals were stuck on your screen even after respawning. They are now properly removed.
[*] Fixed the Trickshot Steam achievement so it should now trigger as intended.
[*] Fixed a bug where you were unable to switch server pages in the browser without selecting a top category.
[*] Fixed a bug so the server browser now correctly shows available server
[*] Fixed an issue where the shop would not show the “SOLD OUT” sign on items with 0 quantity.
[*] Fixed some missing collision elements for the Log Cabin.
[*] Fixed a floating construction yard sign.
[*] Fixed a prevalent crash at the end of the game where the characters are transferred to their victory/defeast poses - hopefully should no longer crash, but please report back if it does.
[*] Fixed a server crash (segmentation 11).
[*] Fixed a crash that occurred upon cancelling a microtransaction and getting stuck on the “Transaction Finished” screen.
[*] Fixed more crashes related to the economy system being affected by various instances.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented rebinding the key for "Dash/Sprint".
[*] Fixed a crash caused by changing character/item skins in the main menu and then in the lobby.
[*] Fixed an issue where a player leaving a self hosted game before they started would cause the game to never start in the first place
[*] Fixed an issue where Chad’s Maid skin would make him bulletproof - perhaps the opposite of intended :D
[*] Fixed a bug, where some of the neighbors were still displayed as “coming soon” or locked.
[*] Fixed a visual bug, where the match endscreen displayed a different result (win instead of lose and vice versa).
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur on player death.
[*] Fixed a bug, where the game ends before the end of the warmup period even starts.
[*] Fixed various crashes related to the party invitation system.
[*] Fixed an issue that made it so you would not receive party invites correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue that would cause items to hang in mid air when swiftly switching between items.
[/list]

[b][u][h2]Known issues[/h2][/u][/b]
We are aware of prolonged match times especially for more skilled players - We are currently working on solutions to alleviate these issues.,

[/expand]

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Launch Recap[/b] 🎂[/h1]

Exactly three weeks ago, we released Neighbors: Suburban Warfare into Early Access and it has honestly been overwhelming to see players brawl it out in Heartsville. First of all we want to say [b]thank you.[/b] 💓

Thank you for playing. Thank you for streaming, reviewing, giving feedback (be it on our Discord or in the Steam forum) - and yes, even refunding. Every signal you’ve sent us has helped to clarify where the game shines and where we need to do better. 

[b]And today, we want to share how we’re in the process of fixing it and what we aim to do.[/b] But let’s take a step back first and look at what happened since the release. 
[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Early Access release growing pains[/b] 💥[/h1]

Upon release it became apparent that Neighbors has some flaws. And naturally we want to fix these flaws as fast as possible. We’ve heard your feedback clearly and if we sum up the three most important issues it would be:  
[h3]
[list]
[b][*] Lag and Hit registration 
[*] Crashes 
[*] Snowballing & Balancing[/b]
[/list][/h3]
The first two issues are technical issues, which are uncovered by having so many players and we take them very seriously. We are however confident that with a little bit of time we will fix these. More on that later.

Snowballing & balancing however is a big problem, and we feel the way the game is set up now encourages it with having the deciding fight right at the beginning of the game. In some instances, players left the game immediately after losing the first resource fight at the construction yard, since the enemy team had upgraded tools and the bigger fence and from that point on…it became incredibly hard to come back. The game is focused around winning and naturally players left the game. 

For us this development was surprising, since here at Invisible Walls we play the game in a totally different way. Besides being colleagues we are also friends and like friends we play the game for the fun and chaos and dumb moments like getting hit by the truck in the middle of a fight and laughing our asses off. And we wanted the players to experience something similar. 

We want Neighbors to be a game where players [b]have fun no matter if they lose or win[/b]!

[hr][/hr]
[h1][b]Game mode rework - Begone Resources![/b] 🦺[/h1]

In order to achieve this we are taking a drastic change to our base game mode. We’ve tried to alleviate it with changes to the economy, changing the costs for certain items like the crowbar and other minor changes. They were sometimes more and sometimes less effective, but the general “sweatiness” of the game was still there. 

Today we are putting out another solution, which hopefully has a big impact on how the game is played: [h3][b]We are getting rid of resources. [/b][/h3]

Or to be more precise we are removing the necessity of resources to upgrade your house level and thus the shop. The crates will still be in the game, but they will give you money instead. The shop will now upgrade after every day enabling you to buy the next tier of items after every day. 

So, a Day 1 battle will only have the Tier 1 items, and so on. Ultimately the Super Jackhammer will spawn, if after a certain amount of time a winner has not been decided. Also the fences upgrade every night - so one less thing to worry about.  

With this change we want to reduce the importance of the early game skirmish and reduce the tilt factor, which leads to early match surrenders and leaving the game and also make it more even throughout the entire match and forgiving for new players.

This is a drastic change, but we think that this allows for a more even game if players have access to the same items every day. Since these changes are significant we don’t want to just put them out there without proper testing: This is why [b]we are releasing the new game mode on a Steam Test branch![/b]

[b]To join the and test the new mode you need to go over to Steam, click properties and select the beta branch called ResourceRework[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/88f63787a56364d6f8102d3a279530d32cc98189.png[/img]

We are leaving it open until next week to see how the players like the changes and collect feedback. 

We firmly believe these changes lead to a more enjoyable player experience, where it is more fun for established and also new players coming in.

[hr][/hr]

[b]Please sign up for the new beta branch if you are curious and keep giving us your thoughts on the game![/b]

We’ll see you in the neighborhood - The NSW dev team. 🏡

[b]Hey there Neighbors![/b]

Hope you've had a good weekend, with a few neighborhood brawls! 💥 This week is going to be a big one for Neighbors, with [b]updates in the game, as well as more info on future upcoming content.[/b]

We'll kick the week off by posting the curated version of the[b] live Q&A our CEO[/b] did this Friday. For a detailed breakdown of a bunch of the questions you've had since launch, check out the video! 🙏

[previewyoutube=Wcs9l5sWp4c;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]For you who don't have the time to watch the whole thing, here's a compact text version of the content:[/b]

[b]Q: Why is the matchmaking system sometimes unfair?[/b]
A: The matchmaking system has been a work in progress, especially during the early days. Initially, players had a lot of experience due to pre-launch play sessions, which led to unfair matchups. We're making improvements, including introducing a "new player" tag to help beginners get a more balanced experience in their early matches.


[b]Q: What is the plan to balance characters?[/b]
A: Balancing is an ongoing challenge, especially as a small indie studio. We're working to adjust characters that don’t work as intended, like PA and Kim. The goal is to strike a balance without aiming for a perfectly balanced game. We want to ensure each character feels unique and satisfying to play.


[b]Q: Are there any technical issues being worked on?[/b]
A: Yes, we are constantly working on technical improvements. Some of the issues being addressed include hit registration, lag, and improving the overall gameplay feel. We’ve already implemented multiple patches to fix various technical issues, and we have a large update planned for the near future that will address these problems even further.


[b]Q: Is there a penalty for dropping out of a game?[/b]
A: Currently, there is no penalty for leaving a game, especially in casual play. Instead, we aim to reward players who stay through the entire match, even if they lose, with a bonus multiplier for their next game. However, we are considering changes in the future, such as making early-leaving more costly to the player who chooses those actions.


[b]Q: Is there any plan to improve the anti-cheat system?[/b]
A: Yes, we are implementing stronger anti-cheat measures, including player reporting. A system is being put in place to allow players to report cheaters in-game, and we'll take action based on those reports.


[b]Q: Will there be more game modes in the future?[/b]
A: Yes, more game modes are on the way! The next update will include a classic team deathmatch mode, with even more crazy modes planned for the future.


Q: Will the game feature more neighbors in the future?[b]
[/b]A: Yes! There are already two new neighbors in the pipeline, each with unique abilities. Stay tuned for the official roadmap next week to see when they’ll be added.


[b]Q: Are there any plans for a console release?[/b]
A: A console release is in the distant future. For now, the focus is on optimizing the game for Steam, as it allows for faster iteration and testing based on player feedback.


[b]Q: Is there a plan to add more events or challenges in the game?[/b]
A: Yes, we're planning to add more achievements and challenges. The goal is to make the progression system more rewarding with unique milestones to achieve.


[b]Q: Are there any plans to add a ranked or competitive mode?[/b]
A: While we're not planning a ranked mode, there will be a competitive mode for players who want to focus on more intense gameplay. This is something that's coming soon.


[b]Q: Will there be more skins or content after level 20?[/b]
A: Yes, we plan to extend the progression system. More skins and content will be added for players who reach higher levels, though we want to avoid adding too many tiered skins in between.


[b]Q: What was the reception of the game’s launch?[/b]
A: The launch wasn't a runaway success, but it met our expectations. We’re focusing on long-term improvement and expanding the game with more features, game modes, and content.

[h2]Hello Neighbors![/h2]

First of all, a massive thank you for your support during these first few days of the Neighbors: Suburban Warfare Early Access release. 

[b]We launched Neighbors: Suburban Warfare into Early Access because we need you to be part of the journey[/b] and help us make this into something special. While the majority of you have recognized the potential and shown your appreciation of the world we are building, it is clear that we need to address the initial state of the game.

Your feedback through this first phase has been invaluable. Over the first couple of days we released a series of hotfixes that addressed some of the early balancing issues while also trying to mitigate issues with lag and matchmaking. However, we are far from done, we know.

Instead of presenting our Roadmap we recognize there are [b]some fundamental areas we need to set straight first. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/cf90bacb194f4cd79dac1861dbc5a649b211db8f.png[/img]

[b][h2]HERE ARE THE THINGS WE WILL FIX FIRST[/h2][/b]
[h3][b]New Player Experience & Balancing[/b][/h3]
It quickly became clear that our matchmaking didn’t work effectively in grouping new players and experienced players. This, on top of a game that has a noticeable learning curve and still lacked proper balancing clearly ended in a lot of players having a rough time. We are currently working on:
[list]
[*] Improved matchmaking and a “New Player” experience where you are only grouped together with other new players.
[*] Simplification of “Resources” to reduce complexity, snowballing effects and make the game more intuitive in general
[*] Re-work of traps and movement impairing effects to reduce frustrating game moments
[*] General Balancing and tweaking of perks to reduce advantage through progression and instead focus on evolving gameplay styles.
[*] Introduction of an “Item Bar with Hotkeys” to make item handling less convoluted
[/list]
[h3][b]Hit Reg, Lag and Game Feel[/b][/h3]
A lot of players have reported fundamental issues with Hit Registration, Lag and/or Game Feel. We are hard at work at this and while this will be a continuous effort we hope we in our next few updates will be able to solve the majority of reported issues by.
[list]
[*] Improving region matching
[*] Tweaking of projectiles and charged effects
[*] Improving Item Switching
[/list]
[h3][b]Technical Issues and Cheaters[/b][/h3]
Finally - we have run into a series of challenges where our attempt at mitigating cheaters unfortunately lead to a lot of players getting a black screen instead of being able to launch the game. We are constantly looking into this since day one and we hope we have finally managed to solve the black screen issue. However, we recognise that cheating is increasingly a  problem. For this reason, we will try to get the following into our next updates::
[list]
[*] A report system to help us collect information on cheaters
[*] Improved Anti Cheat
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/cf90bacb194f4cd79dac1861dbc5a649b211db8f.png[/img]

[b][h2]WHAT'S NEXT[/h2][/b]
Above improvements are our highest priority for now, but rest assured we are also working on bringing you more content in the form of maps, game modes and Neighbors. 

[h3][b]Join the Conversation - Your Feedback Shapes This Game[/b][/h3]
We want your thoughts, questions, weird screenshots and chatter. Please [url=https://discord.gg/jvxCcAUQyB]head over to our official Discord channel[/url] - it’s the best place to:
[list]
[*] Share feedback directly with us
[*] Get early info on upcoming patches and events
[*] Scream about the jackhammer with us
[/list]
From the whole dev team, thank you again for your trust and energy. This is just the start - we’re in this together and we can’t wait to build the future of Neighbors with you.


Hope to see you in game soon!
Invisible Walls

notes.title: Heartsville News #3 | Translators Assemble!
notes.notes:
Hello NEIGHBORS and welcome to the first Steam Update in 2025!
We cooked up a pretty [b]big one [/b]so let's get started! 

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Content of todays update:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] 🧑‍💻 Feedback, polishing and getting back into action
[*] 🧑‍🏫 Community Translation
[*] 🎮 Q1 Playtest Announcement
[*] 📹Content Studio

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Back from the Holidays & Full Steam Ahead![/b]🧑‍💻[/h2]

We're back and on track. 😎 
The break gave us tons of energy to iron out bugs, glitches and adjusting various item values and game settings. So after the holidays we jumped right back into it and started to implement one feedback point after another. 

What all this translates into at a Game Developer? A loooot of meetings and discussions regarding balancing, items, game length etc. We can't wait to share what we've been working on later this week. 
 
But speaking of translating: We [u]NEED[/u] your help! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/69032204109d2e221e958ed650775ccafe964e43.png[/img][i]CEO David going through all changes in the next sprints together with the team. [/i]


[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Community Translators Assemble![/b]🧑‍🏫[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/ca989b4e37ddf1594e56c8ef731158fec2c4b53e.png[/img]

Our game's [i]getting love worldwide[/i] and we've received quite a few request to offer support for more languages. Currently we have a 100% functional translation into English and - of course - Danish. But we recognize, that we should offer more. But it's hard for us to assess which languages we should focus on and we don't have the ressources to review every translation we receive. Aaand that's where [i]Crowdin[/i] comes in. 

[h3][b]How it works[/b][/h3]Using Crowdin we are opening up [b]a direct way to shape the game[/b], because YOU can actually help us translating the game into your native languages. Crowdin is directly tied to our current development branch of the game and regularly (every few minutes) implements all approved translations directly into the game.

[h3]Step 1: Sign up on Crowdin following [url=https://crowdin.com/project/justperfect/invite?h=acb8bde110b6e8fc07e6f69843141ee42320503]this[/url] link. [/h3]
In order to participate in the community translation you will need to create an account on Crowdin. Whether you are using your real name or an alternative nickname is yours to decide, but we will use your name in the credits when you've submitted [b]at least 2000 words[/b]. 


[h3]Step 2: Choose the language you want to translate OR request your language via Discord[/h3]
After setting up your account you should now be able to become a translator in the project called [i]Motheaten/NEIGHBORS: Suburban Warfare[/i] and see the overview page with all languages, which are implemented right now. 

[u]What if my desired language is not set up yet? [/u] If you want to [b]add another language[/b] please make sure to be a member on our [url=https://discord.gg/VJqvFrKwF8]Discord server[/url] and to reach out to me directly (@artimcf1y). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/473bd947c5ee0fcedb1dce427f44a2458ced80ba.png[/img][i]In the Project Overview you can see all languages, which are set up and their progress.[/i]


Every language will consist of three files, which are copied over in "almost realtime" into the game. The main file for the majority of translations is always called [b]game.po[/b]. The other two files should be named [b]Steam Store Page[/b] and [b]Welcome Neighbors - (Steam news post)[/b]. As we plan to update the store page itself with new descriptions fairly soon feel free to disregard this for now. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/c3b3679db14538aa9f380799866150564879f155.png[/img][i] Every language features three files. The most important one being "game.po" [/i]


[h3]Step 3: Add a translation and rate submissions [/h3]
And this is where the fun begins! After choosing your language you will have an overview of all 12.308 strings, which need to be translated. It features item descriptions, key words, skills, neighbor descriptions, tooltips and more. Feel free to choose the strings you are most comfortable with and type in the translation in this overview or select specific strings to rate already submitted translations. 



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/d6ac41141c1c15dc193b24a9e0eef03dd7255a93.png[/img][i]Use the filter and search settings to find the strings you want to translate. Type in your translations under the "Translation" column[/i]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/d67000f22896800e0d85fbe3ae09ebc495b3d056.png[/img]
[i]Choosing a string will open this view on the right. Here you can see the string details, rate other submissions and compare the translation to other languages. [/i]



[h3]Step 4: Reach 2000 submitted words and be immortalized in the game. [/h3]
So If you're up for helping translate, we'd be forever grateful and if your account has translated [b]2000 words[/b] for the game you will be immortalized in the Credits + receive a digital token (we haven't yet decided what exactly, but it should be visible in the game like e.g. a "Heartsville Press" skin for a weapon or something). 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/8c1c8b5ca60b174c29981f56ff9e5f33da2e49be.png[/img]
[i]The game.po consists of 12.308 different strings, which need to be translated [/i]


Stay tuned for more on this later in Q1!
Thanks in advance to everyone contributing. :) 


[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Not one but TWO playtests! 
Playtest Q1 Announcement.[/b]🎮[/h2]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/46066af099c5af4fb1965a68e3b19a8b6989acf0.png[/img]

Oh yeah. The most famous P-Word in Heartsville is back! 
We're excited to announce, that we decided to not have one, but [b]two[/b] playtests in [b]Q1[/b]. Please see the dates and timings below: 


[h3][b]Playtest 1- Stability Playtest[/b][/h3]
[b]Friday, January 17th [12:00] - Monday, January 20th [10:00][/b]


[h3][b]Playtest 2- Major Playtest[/b][/h3]
[b]Tuesday, February 11th [12:00] - Monday, February 17th [10:00][/b]


[i]Why two?[/i] 
To be frank we just want to test all the feedback we have implemented since the last playtest back in December. Back then we received feedback regarding [b]game breaking bugs and crashes[/b], which hindered some players to have a fully-fledged experience with the game. That means we gave access to testers, who couldn't really play the game, which is...yeah...unfortunate. To make sure the game runs smoothly before we let in more than double the current amount of testers we've decided to squeeze in this so-called "Stability Playtest" right before that.

Chances are reasonably high, that may [u]not[/u] receive an invite despite having wishlisted the game. We are sorry for that, but hopefully you find solace in the fact, that the big playtest is in [b]less than a month [/b]so you possibly don't have to wait too long. 

We'll come around with a [i]detailed breakdown of changes we implemented[/i] since the last playtest in another Steam Update right before the launch of this weeks Stability Playtest. 

Make sure to[i] Follow[/i] the game on Steam to see the news asap!

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/e383de09b32cc6b8378ad6e5f7010807b113821e.png[/img]

Greetings NEIGHBORS,

In this update we would like to introduce our newest colleague at Invisible Walls and give you an update on what we are currently working on:


[h1][b]THE NEW KID IN THE NEIGHBORHOOD[/b][/h1]
As we mentioned in last week's update, we are very happy to welcome a new member to the [b]Invisible Walls[/b] crew: [b]Brand & Community Manager[/b] Artjom "ArtiMcFly" Schmatkow has joined the team and will make sure that the Neighbors community will be able to grow happily, celebrate events together and also receive regular insights into current and future updates. 


[i]Hello everyone! 
My name is Artjom and I'm really excited to introduce myself ːsteamhappyː

I've been in the industry for roughly six year now and after moving from Germany to Denmark last year, I was looking for a job to work even closer with video game development and to be part of something really special. And after only a few short visits I am convinced, that I found the perfect spot here with the amazing team at Invisible Walls. 

As soon as I stepped into the cozy studio right in the heart of Copenhagen I was wholeheartedly welcomed by the entire the team and I can really feel the passion and love they put into Neighbors: Suburban Warfare every single day. That's something I would love to share with you in future streams, on social media and on our beloved community Discord (link down below). 

[i]Whether it's sharing updates, gathering feedback, or just geeking out over games, I'm here to make this journey as engaging and fun as possible. So don't hesitate to reach out to me via Discord or the Steam Community Forum. Let's build something great together!
[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/a9dc590c2a5656357f0cad052604c22689748eda.png[/img][i] Me, our IT Wizard Spoisen and our CEO David "decorating" the studio for our Halloween Party. [/i]


[hr][/hr][/i]

[h1][b]WHAT WE ARE CURRENTLY WORKING ON[/b][/h1]
Last time we mentioned that we are working hard on delivering a build for future playtests. While we're at it, we'd like to periodically share a little bit of what [i]exactly[/i] we're working on right now to involve you more into our day-to-day progress.



[b]HOW TO DEFEND YOUR PROPERTY[/b]
One of our main focuses after the last playtests was to make the game as easy to understand as possible for newcomers. That's why we're currently working hard to create a tutorial that will give you the tools you need to defend your property. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/bdb34e5cbb9654d0832f7c8357bdd76723310317.gif[/img]

For example, to fend off annoying neighbors, you will learn where to collect and buy items such as the good old bear trap. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/562e2d857de479b8365d351d2652508fb1e51e51.gif[/img]

Every house has its weak points, which the neighborhood can use to get rid of your important furniture. In the tutorial you will, among other things, learn where to place the traps. If not, you will learn the hard way when your TV is smashed to pieces. 



[b]ITEM SHOP OVERHAUL[/b]
Items are a core element of Neighbors: Suburban Warfare to either fend off annoying neighbors or to "redecorate" their homes and furniture. Currently, we are looking to streamline and optimize the shop system where you can get all of your weapons, tools, and utilities such as baseball bats, automatic baseball pitchers or the infamous [i]Seagull-130 Gunbird[/i]. 

As you can see below, we are experimenting with visualizing all unlocked items in the item shop and making it more easy to navigate. Right now we are working on a new closet that will pop open when you run by.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/beb9482572fd742603222581fedf25f6271f017b.png[/img]



[b]ITEM EXPLORATION FEATURING "THE PLUNGERGUN"[/b]
We love taking everyday objects you might find in a sleepy suburban neighborhood and turning them into silly tools and traps. Regularly we are looking to either create new or adapt existing items to enable the chaotic neighborhood scuffles we all desire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/0eb0a28427eeba99b550bfd2b2f048652475d498.png[/img]

One of the items we are currently testing is the handy "Plungergun" that shoots... well, plungers. Why you ask? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/ef0b7edf5b5bd25903a4592c9a68bae1dcc5fc7c.gif[/img]
So you can pull [strike]LITTLE SH*TS[/strike] Kevin players shooting at you from above down from the roof. OR you can pull yourself up to higher ground to teach them a lesson. With your fists...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/7a623ff36236b4f329c93e20d4e72cb153eb163d.gif[/img]


[b]NO PARTY? NO PROBLEM. QUICK PLAY IS HERE![/b]
In previous builds, players could only host or join lobbies to fight each other. These are still viable options, and ideal if you are looking for custom experience. However we have been hard at work at adding a "quick play" option so you can jump directly into 3v3 suburban clashes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/9104b86d4e5251313cbcaa33cfca080ee5969922.png[/img]



[b]FUTURE UPDATES[/b]
Expect regular development updates in the coming weeks as we strive to deliver a playable build for future playtests. We really appreciate the interest in the game, and until you are able to pester your beloved neighbors (in-game!), we want to share as much as we can about the game.

We get a lot of questions asking for a playtest date, and we [b]promise[/b] to be transparent with updates as soon as we have some. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/fcc5ec85e749632e481d0500172910a1c8c11c1e.png[/img]

Be sure to also Wishlist & Follow [u]Neighbors: Suburban Warfare[/u] on Steam to stay on top of any notifications and receive similar behind-the-scenes updates like this one. 

Until next time!

[b]Hello NEIGHBORS![/b]
We are absolutely thrilled for the excitement and feedback we have received in the days following our name reveal at theSPILL a few weeks ago.

The interest in Neighbors: Suburban Warfare have blown our minds and we can’t wait to bring this project to fruition together with you all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/f6816c473e557b263a3dd1c4a584d1831356a670.png[/img][i]Troels and Katarina before we went live at theSPILL - find the link below to see how it went[/i]


[h1][b]LETS START WITH A SMALL FAQ[/b][/h1]
Since the reveal we have received a lot of questions and therefore felt that a FAQ format could be a good idea for us to post to get all our new neighbors on board. So here goes:


[h5][b]WHEN CAN I PLAYTEST THE GAME?[/b][/h5]
We are not ready to give a date for the next playtest yet. We are hard at work implementing feedback from our last playtest to the game. Since the reveal, the number of playtest signups have increased more than we anticipated. While this is awesome in every single way it also puts more stress on our systems. We want to get this right and we will do our best to give access to as many Neighbors as possible. That said, the wait might be longer for some of you. We will update you as soon as we know, promise.


[h5][b]AM I ALLOWED TO STREAM AND SHARE CONTENT FROM PLAYTESTS?[/b][/h5]
Good question. Neighbors: Suburban Warfare is like a baby to us. And while we love it dearly, others might still find it a little rough around the edges. For this reason there is a chance that we would kindly ask for your discretion during the early playtests so that we can address your feedback before we spread it wider. If you are a streamer/content creator looking to stream the game, our IW Prelude Program might be of interest to you. Sign Up here: https://www.invisiblewalls.co/prelude



[h5][b]WHAT TYPE OF GAME IS NEIGHBORS: SUBURBAN WARFARE?[/b][/h5]
Neighbors: Suburban Warfare combines all our favorite elements from established Shooters, Brawlers,  MOBAs and Base Builders into a light-hearted setting where everyone can play along. It does not necessarily fall into a neatly definable box. Regardless of what type it is, we like it. And we hope you will too.


[h5][b]IS IT A MULTIPLAYER GAME?[/b][/h5]
Yes, Neighbors: Suburban Warfare is a team-based multiplayer game for 2-8 players. There might come free-for-all game modes as development moves on if it works well during testing.


[h5][b]WHEN WILL THE GAME RELEASE[/b][/h5]
Another good question. Right now our focus is on getting the playtest going so we can get a feel for the remaining work we have in front of us. For this reason we will not speculate in possible release dates yet.  


[h5][b]IS LELOI A REAL DOG?[/b][/h5]
Yes, Leloi is heavily inspired by a real dog. We love animals and we love pets. We have several on a regular basis at the office, one of which is Leloi. Will we add the rest as well? Very likely.


[h5][b]WILL YOU BE ABLE TO PET THE PETS?[/b][/h5]
Yes.


[h5][b]WILL THERE BE A ROADMAP?[/b][/h5]
Yes. We are currently working on fleshing one out. It will most likely change during playtesting but we aim to have something to steer us. 


[h5][b]WHERE CAN I FIND MORE INFORMATION?[/b][/h5]
You can read more about the game and the Neighbors on our website: www.neighborsgame.com


You can also watch (or rewatch) our segment from theSPILL here: https://www.youtube.com/live/pTBCH6PKev4?t=10215s


And finally, you can join of Discord community where we discuss and show new stuff from the game:

On behalf of the entire Neighborhood, we want to thank you for reading. We expect to be back next week to introduce a new member of the team and show what we are cooking for the playtest.

If you haven’t done so already, please consider to wishlist the game!

notes.notes:
Hello Heartsville!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504685/db9827561c92a89a9557919c5fb27435fa5face4.png[/img]

	It’s been a busy few months for all of us at Invisible Walls. We set our sights on running a playtest, and the whole team came together to pull it off. We also owe a thanks to those of you who made it for some of the test sessions. It was so wonderful to see people enjoying Just Perfect, and it was even more wonderful to get all of your feedback. 

	We want to make sure Just Perfect starts off on the right foot and achieving that will require a lot of humility. We received a lot of feedback during the playtest - some good, some bad. We know the art team appreciates the praise, and we know that our Game Designer appreciates everyone’s patience and willingness to learn..

	[b]Sebastian:[/b] [i]It was nice to see how many players joined our last test and showed up with enthusiasm to play Just Perfect this early in the development phase. We are very aware that the game currently does not tell you how to play, guide you or inform you in terms of what is going on around you. The next big step we are taking with the game will include making these matters more clear. I was surprised by everyone's patience to learn the game and once players got the hang of it, many stuck around and played for hours. We also got an overwhelming amount of feedback from everyone and this is truly very helpful and something we are basing our development and planning on, so thank you very much for helping us and Just Perfect on the correct path towards a great game🙏[/i]

	We learned a lot from the playtest. One of the biggest things we learned was just how hard Just Perfect is to learn. This was a little expected as we haven’t prepared a full tutorial for the game. What we noticed though turned out to be a major gap whenever newer players were up against someone with even a little bit of play time. We don’t expect Just Perfect to be an overly complex game, but we’re aware of the nuances to it. The team will be looking into different options for tutorials to help make life easier for those who move into the neighborhood later on.

	We can’t reveal everything we learned, but we can say there was so much more. Every piece of feedback we’ve received will help make Just Perfect into a better game at launch. 

	We want to wish everyone a wonderful holiday season and a happy new year. We’re looking forward to what the future holds for Just Perfect and we’re so excited to share more with you next year. 

	Thank you so much for reading. If you’re interested in Just Perfect, please add the game to your wishlist and follow us on your preferred platforms to stay up-to-date.
